name: niibot
description: 多平台直播整合 Bot - 支援 Twitch 和 Discord。

scripts.lint-all: npm run lint --prefix frontend && ruff check backend
scripts.format-all: npm run format --prefix frontend && ruff format backend
scripts.build:all: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml --profile full build
scripts.build:api: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml build api
scripts.dev:api: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml --profile api up
scripts.dev:twitch: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml --profile twitch up
scripts.dev:discord: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml --profile discord up
scripts.dev:bots: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml --profile bots up
scripts.dev:full: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml --profile full up
scripts.docker:db: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml up postgres

backend/**/*.py: uv run --project backend ruff check --fix --config backend/pyproject.toml --cache-dir backend/.cache/ruff
uv run --project backend ruff format --config backend/pyproject.toml --cache-dir backend/.cache/ruff
